page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs using the x86_64 architecture, indicating a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio with no hyperthreading. The processing power is delivered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The lack of local storage and hardware acceleration represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance for workloads reliant on network-attached storage and CPU-bound processing rather than local disk I/O or parallelized GPU computing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers high resource density within the general-purpose tier, consolidating 128 dedicated cores and a substantial memory footprint into a single virtual machine. This configuration is suitable for large-scale enterprise applications, web serving, distributed microservices, and general-purpose workloads that require high CPU core counts and a balanced memory-to-CPU ratio without the need for specialized hardware accelerators.
